svg.title: Stack technique
svg.desc: Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12, Node.js / NestJS, TypeScript; Interfaces: REST, WebSockets, gRPC, Webhooks, Sanctum, Spatie Permission; Frontend: Vue 3, Nuxt, React, Next.js, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS; Mobile: Flutter, Dart, GetX, Provider; Données: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma; DevOps: Linux, Docker, Compose, Nginx, GitLab CI/CD, VPS; Paiements: Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Stripe, CinetPay, NotchPay, FreemoPay. In progress, learning: Go, IA : LLM, Tool calling, Agents, RAG. Domains, not proficiency levels.
